Neurodevelopmental disorder; strabismus in 3/6 and hip dysplasia in 2/4 support ocular and skeletal involvement. Reflux is a separate diagnosis.
Congenital enlargement of the cisterna magna, a posterior fossa cerebrospinal fluid space; often asymptomatic.
Hamartomatous polyposis of the gastrointestinal tract. Anemia from intestinal blood loss is secondary, not direct hematologic disease.
Retinal dystrophy, obesity/hypogonadism and neurodevelopmental impairment define it; kidney disease occurs in 30-79%. Skeletal and dental abnormalities omitted by cap.
Astrocytic tumor arising in the cerebral hemispheres, often involving adjacent meninges.
Focal epilepsy arising from the primary motor cortex.
Atherosclerotic plaque directly affects coronary arteries despite less than 50% stenosis.
Developmental delay, seizures and regression define neurologic involvement; toe syndactyly and toenail dysplasia each occur in 30-79%. Facial and ear shapes alone add no axes.
FG syndrome is a neurodevelopmental syndrome with developmental impairment and hypotonia. Constipation alone does not establish direct gastrointestinal damage.
Nemaline bodies and progressive weakness reflect skeletal muscle disease. Cardiomyopathy is under 30%; paraproteinemia is an associated separate condition.
Reactive leukocytosis with immature neutrophils; the definition supports a blood abnormality despite the misleading neoplasm parent.
Inherited CYCS-related platelet disorder; thrombocytopenia reported in 29/29 patients.
Autoimmune blistering skin disease; destructive oral mucosal blistering and erosions occur in 80-99%, supporting gastrointestinal involvement.
Developmental disability and CNS malformations; hydronephrosis, patent ductus arteriosus and strabismus each occur in 30-79%. Skeletal malformations omitted by cap.
Adenoid cystic carcinoma arising in the lacrimal gland, part of the ocular axis.
BAFopathy denotes a neurodevelopmental syndrome. No supplied phenotype establishes another commonly damaged organ.
Herpes simplex virus directly infects skin, producing vesicular dermatitis. Eyelid involvement is not established across this umbrella concept.
Tumor arises in the ampulla at the terminal bile duct and duodenal junction; supplied ancestry explicitly includes both extrahepatic bile duct and duodenal carcinoma.
Inherited myxomatous mitral valve disease defined by prolapse and mitral regurgitation.
Inflammation directly affects brain and meninges, generally from bacterial, viral, fungal or protozoal infection.
Motor axonal neuropathy with common chronic muscle wasting and fixed deformities; hammertoes in 5/5 and upper-limb amyotrophy in 2/2 support musculoskeletal involvement.
Malignant germ cell tumor located in the central nervous system; yolk sac differentiation does not imply reproductive organ involvement.
Myosin storage disease directly affects skeletal muscle. Reduced vital capacity in 1/4 is below threshold and reflects muscle weakness; cardiac disease is not established.
Familial cutaneous lupus and type I interferonopathy causing inflammatory chilblain skin lesions; no common extracutaneous damage is established.
